facts.fact: Revises F426: the closing is done in the gate-chamber directly over the padippura, under the same roof. Neela signs as the warden's wife, 'of Kettamala', as household witness on a border-law writ that goes to Kodiyur. No earlier refusal to put her word before the queen is stated or implied. Devan sees her choice only in her hands. Ittan's tokens and the grey-sealed letter are said to go 'to the palace' or 'to Kodiyur', not north or south.
